events.title: Bram Moolenaar releases Vim
events.summary: Bram Moolenaar released Vim 1.14 on November 2, 1991 — the Vi IMitation editor for Amiga that became the default for terminal-centric developers.
events.about: Vim's modal editing, macros, and plugin ecosystem shaped how sysadmins and programmers edit remote servers. It remains among the most installed developer tools worldwide.

narrative.whyChosen: Vim defined modal text editing for a generation of terminal users.
narrative.whyImportant: It kept powerful keyboard-driven editing viable on constrained systems.
narrative.problemSolved: vi was inconsistent across Unix variants and lacked extensibility.
